blind_rule: Classify the route actually proposed by response text alone. Do not infer from ID, repair, solve, or consult prompts, gold labels, prior audits, contrast reports, or other outputs before sealing.
recognizable_route_rule: true iff the response text itself proposes one of the five defined route mechanisms; otherwise false
seal_protocol: Compute SHA-256 of judgments.jsonl and this manifest.json before opening any gold-bearing prompt file; record those hashes in seal.sha256.
